jobs.description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses
  
  

* Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Artist and Brand Manager - Merchandise
  
  
**A Little Bit About Our Team**
Homemade / WMX is Warner Music Group’s merchandise and e-commerce services division, focused on helping artists connect with fans through merchandise, physical music, touring, VIP ticketing, retail, licensing and direct-to-consumer experiences.
  
  
We work at the intersection of creativity and commerce, partnering with artists, managers, and label teams to build thoughtful, high-quality products and experiences that fans care about, and marketing them to drive revenue and add value to our clients business. From artist stores and limited-edition vinyl to tour merchandise and global retail programs, we treat merch and physical products as meaningful extensions of an artist’s creative vision.
  
  
Homemade / WMX combines the global scale of Warner Music Group with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach. We value collaboration, ownership, and curiosity, and we’re building a forward-thinking team that’s excited to evolve how artists reach and engage their audiences
  
  
**Your Role**
As the Artist and Brand Manager - Merchandise, you will be a dedicated merchandise lead for WMX. Reporting directly to the Artist and Brand Director, you will manage the day-to-day execution of merchandise strategies for a diverse roster ranging from developing artists to established global acts.
  
  
You will act as a crucial link between label teams, artist management, and WMX's internal departments to ensure merchandise campaigns are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest creative standard.
  
  
Ecommerce plays a large part for this role and creating great products, campaigns and driving sales for our artists. The role also gets to work with all channels of our business across touring, retail, licensing, VIP and experiential and work closely with label marketing teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Label & Artist Coordination
  
  

* Day-to-Day Liaison: Serve as the primary daily contact for artist managers and label contacts regarding all merchandise needs and reporting executiive level summaries for label leads.

**Artist Development**

* Work closely with the Director to tailor merchandise strategies to the artist's career stage, guiding developing artists through their first merch drops while scaling up operations for established acts.
* Cross-Functional Execution: Coordinate seamlessly with internal departments (Creative, E-commerce, Production, VIP, and Pop-ups) to ensure all elements of a campaign are executed flawlessly.

**Product & Campaign Execution**

* Calendar Management: Build, maintain, and enforce merchandise calendars, ensuring product ranges are planned and delivered in time for key moments and achieving commercial objectives (touring, album releases, D2C drops).

**Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the central and label marketing teams to ensure full support for product launches.

**Creative Collaboration**

* Brief the creative teams effectively, bringing an understanding of current fashion trends and the specific aesthetic of your artists to the table.
* Quality Control: Review samples and production proofs to ensure the final product authentically represents the artist and meets WMX’s quality standards.

**Project & Budget Management**

* Campaign Tracking: Project manage multiple merchandise drops simultaneously, keeping all stakeholders updated on timelines, production statuses, comercial results and delivery dates.
* Budget Administration: Track day-to-day campaign spending, ensuring production and marketing costs align with the allocated budgets and profitability goals set by the Director.

**About You**
Industry Experience: Proven experience (typically minimum 2-5 years) in brand management, merchandise, licensing, ecommerce or marketing, preferably within the music, entertainment, or fashion industries.
  
  
**We’d Love It If You Also Had**

* Great communication and ability to multi task
* Airtable experience a positive or project management software
* Great at working to deadlines and managing multiple stakeholders
* Interest music, fashion, retail, merchandise and creative
* Working with high retailers desired
* E-commerce range planning experience

We're partnering with one of the UK's best-loved independent music festivals. It has over 25 years of history, a knack for booking the right bands at the right moment, and a community-first, hand-built feel that bigger events can't fake. It sits within a leading international festival group, so you get the warmth and personality of an independent brand with the backing of a much bigger business behind it.

Each festival in the portfolio has its own dedicated marketing lead who lives and breathes the brand, supported by central CRM and performance specialists. This hire takes over from a long-standing marketer who is moving on. The aim is a January start, giving a proper handover ahead of line-up announcements and on-sales. You'll report into the Festival Manager, with guidance from a senior marketer in the group. The role is digital-first, heavy on content and hands-on, and suits a strong senior executive ready to step up or a marketing manager who still loves being close to the work.

**The Role**

* Own the festival's marketing campaign day to day, from planning the timeline to delivery across social, content, PR and digital.
* Lead the festival's social channels: create, schedule and community-manage content, including being on hand when big announcements land.
* Create content yourself using CapCut, Adobe Suite and in-app tools, and brief the photographers, filmmakers and UGC creators on site.
* Run all artist announcements. You'll be the point of contact for bookers and make sure every line-up asset is approved and billed correctly.
* Build a top-line marketing plan and present plans and key assets to festival stakeholders for sign-off.
* Work alongside central CRM and performance specialists, making sure everything they put out is on-brand and true to the festival's tone of voice.
* Manage PR, digital and social agency partners day to day, keeping them briefed, on KPI and within budget.
* Bring on third-party partners and devise promotions and competitions that drive ticket sales and awareness.
* Track campaign performance against KPIs and keep budget trackers and comms calendars sharp and up to date.
* Spend 10+ days on site across build, show and break, plus the odd weekend around announcements and on-sales.

**What You'll Bring**

* Proven experience running marketing and content for a consumer brand. Music, events, ticketing or entertainment is a bonus, not essential.
* A natural feel for TikTok, Instagram and what makes social content land, and real enthusiasm for being on those channels every day.
* Working knowledge of PR and multichannel marketing, and the confidence to build and own a marketing plan.
* A real passion for live music and festivals. You'll be speaking as the brand, so it needs to come naturally.
* Strong hands-on content creation skills, with Adobe Suite and CapCut experience.
* Close attention to detail and solid organisation.
* A hungry, sleeves-up attitude. This suits someone excited to learn and grow, not someone looking to step back from execution.
* Flexibility to work weekends, early mornings and late nights during peak season.
* A full UK driving licence and the right to work in the UK.

**Location & Workplace Policy**

* Central London
* Hybrid working, 3 set days in the office (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday)
* On site at the festival for build, show and break

**Salary & Benefits**

* £40,000 - £50,000 per annum
* 28 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, enhanced parental leaves, matched salary sacrifice pension, life assurance at 4x salary, EV car scheme and season ticket loan, plus private medical insurance and cycle to work coming in April 2027

If you're a digital-first marketer who'd love to put your skills behind a festival, or you're thinking about your next move, I'd love to have a confidential chat. Drop me a line at jodie.clayton@majorplayers.co.uk or connect with me on LinkedIn.

**About The Role**

Our vision is to nurture PEI Group and our business information and event brands to become must-have resources and networks, so that private market investors, managers and service providers can better meet their business objectives and outperform in their markets.

The marketing team will be strategic partners to the business, collaborating to design and deliver customer-centric, creative and high-performance programs which improve brand preference, engage more market professionals and underpin commercial success.

This is a fixed-term maternity cover role. The Marketing Manager – Events, based in London, will own the end-to-end marketing of PEI’s Infrastructure Investor events portfolio: five events a year, comprising the flagship Infrastructure Investor Global Summit (IIGS) and the London, America, Japan and Korea events. Working closely with event producers, delegate and sponsorship sales, editorial and operations colleagues, the Manager will plan and deliver multi-channel campaigns that drive delegate registrations and revenue, secure high-quality investor (LP) attendance, support sponsorship sales and maximise attendee engagement. The successful candidate will need to get up to speed quickly, picking up live campaigns across several events running at different stages of their lifecycle.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the marketing strategy and plan for each of the five Infrastructure events – IIGS, London, America, Japan and Korea – aligned to delegate revenue, investor attendance and sponsorship targets.
* Pick up live campaigns from handover and maintain momentum across events at different points in their cycle (e.g. one event in peak registration while another is launching).
* Build and manage a rolling campaign calendar across the portfolio, balancing overlapping timelines, regions and time zones.
* Develop a deep understanding of the infrastructure investor community – LPs and institutional investors, GPs and fund managers, developers, operators and service providers – segmenting audiences by persona, region and seniority.
* Use historical event data (registrations, attendee mix, conversion and rebook rates) to forecast, set pacing targets and identify growth opportunities.
* Partner with event producers and content teams to turn agendas, speakers and themes into compelling, audience-specific campaign messaging.
* Tailor marketing for the Asia-Pacific events (Japan and Korea), taking into account local market dynamics, localisation needs and regional partners.

Day to Day Responsibility

* Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across email (Marketo), paid and organic social (particularly LinkedIn), PPC, website, partner and media-partner channels, and advertising across PEI’s Infrastructure Investor brand.
* Manage event websites and registration pages with the Digital Marketing Operations (DMO) team – agenda and speaker updates, pricing deadlines, offers and promo codes.
* Deliver targeted investor (LP) acquisition programmes, including personalised invitation campaigns and outreach, in collaboration with the event and investor relations teams.
* Support sponsorship sales with prospectuses, sales collateral, sponsor marketing toolkits and sponsor promotion, plus post-event reporting for sponsors.
* Brief Design, Video and DMO teams and external agencies on creative for all stages of the delegate journey – brochures, ads, banners, email, onsite branding and event app content.
* Work with Editorial to cross-promote events through Infrastructure Investor content, newsletters and podcasts.
* Manage media and association partnerships, including partner promotion and reciprocal agreements.
* Report weekly on registrations versus target, channel performance and pacing, with clear recommendations for improvement.
* Manage marketing budgets for each event, tracking spend and return on investment.

Onsite and Post-Event

* Potentially attend events, including international travel to the America, Japan and Korea events and IIGS, supporting onsite marketing, attendee experience and content capture (photography, video and testimonials).
* Lead post-event activity: attendee surveys and NPS, content repurposing, and early-bird and rebook campaigns for the following year.
* Capture and share learnings after each event to continually improve the portfolio’s marketing approach.

Role KPIs

* Achieve delegate registration and paid delegate revenue targets for each event.
* Deliver qualified LP/investor attendance targets, by both volume and quality.
* Drive marketing-contributed sponsorship leads and support sponsor satisfaction and renewal.
* Meet campaign performance benchmarks (e.g. engagement, conversion and cost per registration) within agreed budgets.
* Improve attendee satisfaction (NPS) and year-on-year rebook rates.

**Experience & Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience of 5+ years in B2B event marketing, ideally across a portfolio of conferences with paid delegate and sponsorship revenue.
* Experience in financial services, private markets or infrastructure is highly desirable.
* Track record of marketing multiple events simultaneously to tight deadlines, including international events; experience of Asia-Pacific markets is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with marketing automation (ideally Marketo), CRM (e.g. Salesforce), CMS/event websites, registration platforms and LinkedIn advertising.
* Data-driven – comfortable tracking registrations against target, analysing campaign performance and adjusting plans quickly.
* Copywriting – produces compelling, audience-specific copy that drives registrations and engagement.
* Highly organised – able to juggle overlapping event timelines, priorities and stakeholders.
* Quick to get up to speed – able to pick up a handover and run with live campaigns with minimal ramp-up time.
* Collaborative – builds strong working relationships with producers, sales, editorial, design and operations teams

* People Management:

Designer Parfums is a fast growing, dynamic global fragrance company in the perfume & cosmetics industry, with a UK base in London and international ambition, with active business in around 70 markets.

We are a small family-owned business, and we are proud to create, develop, and distribute brands from a fantastic portfolio of heritage classics to celebrity trend-led fragrances. We are brand owners and licensees for GHOST, JENNIFER LOPEZ, HAWAIIAN TROPIC, CERRUTI, PLAYBOY & JEAN LOUIS SCHERRER and proud to be distributors for ARIANA GRANDE, GUY LAROCHE, PILOMA PICASSO, AIGNER & GANT.

Our employees make our business special. With strong family values, we believe that Designer Parfums is a more prosperous and fun place to work when people feel free to be themselves. We believe in the power of being authentic, Agile and Approachable while meeting our business goals.

**Full-time, Permanent**

**4 days of working from in our London office, 1 day of working from home**

JOB PURPOSE

In a busy industry with thousands of launches each year, aim to make a difference by marketing brands that are relevant to consumers, capturing their essence through cutting-edge olfactory concepts designed in an innovative fashion, in ways that resound with millennial and Gen-Z audiences.

We are seeking a highly motivated, Trade Marketing Manager to join our UK team and shake things up at Designer Parfums challenging the way we work on all things trade marketing! We pride ourselves on being agile and want someone to bring their expertise and innovative ideas to really make an impact. You will be responsible for managing the UK trade marketing plans for our portfolio of exciting brands at Designer Parfums.

This role will involve working closely with retail partners such as Boots, Superdrug, The Perfume shop and more. You will be responsible for reviewing and analysing marketing campaigns to support you in creating and delivering trade marketing strategies, managing the UK activation calendar and budget for both new and existing brands.

With a strong background in Fragrance, FMCG beauty, personal care, or cosmetics you will be disciplined and experienced in driving the demand at wholesale, and retail.

KEYDUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

* Responsible for creating and delivering trade marketing strategies that maximize brand visibility and increase demand with retail and distribution partners.
* Work closely with sales, marketing & brand teams to achieve UK growth ambitions ensuring trade marketing programs are aligned with sales targets and marketing objectives.
* Manage the UK Trade Marketing Calendar and ensure all brand activation plans and artwork requests are executed on time and with excellence.
* Manage day-to-day communications with Key retailer partners buying and marketing teams.
* Present at key customer meetings & provide strong thought leadership on marketing/promotional support.
* Bring creative & disruptive ideas on how to engage customers & consumers.
* Manage the review & analysis of promotional activities to maximize ROI & sales growth across all channels.
* Manage one direct report of Visual merchandising & events manager and ensure the execution of trade events is delivered on time and to brand guidelines.
* Manage the Trade Marketing budget and analyze performance and sell-out reports to optimize results.
* Keep abreast of key competitor launches and marketing activities of retailers to ensure Designer Parfums remain at the forefront of fragrance retailing.
* Work closely with the Visual Merchandising & Events Manager to ensure a strong brand presence in retail accounts, maximize the brand experience, drive key strategic sampling and promotional activation opportunities
* Be the guardian of brand visual presentation liaising with UK Brand team to ensure brand guidelines and visual standards are being implemented across all touch points.
* Proactively and clearly communicate all trade marketing plans and key brand publicity with key stakeholders including retail operations, sales team, warehousing, customer services and management.
* Support the Senior UK Marketing Manager with presenting the UK marketing programme and provide Sales Managers with all appropriate marketing support tools.
* Ensure regular store visits to develop competitor intelligence and keep abreast with market developments.
* Work closely with the Sales Managers to ensure brand forecasts accurately reflect any planned promotional activity and that all activity is communicated well in advance for optimum supply.
* Manage all brand assets and ensure these are shared in a timely manner to 3rd parties; retail marketing and the digital teams as well as internal marketing and VM teams.
* Respond to and follow up on all inquiries from brand teams, sales teams, and accounts teams.
* Support on ad-hoc admin duties within the UK Marketing department (raising purchase orders, securing internal approvals & approving trade invoices)

REQUIREMENTS

* 2+ years in either trade marketing, sales, or marketing in a leading FMCG company
* Fragrance, Personal care, beauty, or cosmetics experience is essential. Experience working in a beauty B2B business is a plus.
* Track record of managing key accounts from a trade marketing perspective
* Marketing qualification or degree preferably in a business-related discipline
* Microsoft Office package knowledge, especially PowerPoint, Excel, SharePoint, Outlook
* Passion for all things beauty.
* Highly motivated, self-starter, and ability to work on their own with minimal supervision to meet strict deadlines
* Excellent verbal and written communication as well as meticulous attention to detail to manage creative detail, copy and design.
* Core understanding of the relationship between Sales and Marketing within a retail, brand, or trade marketing role
* Must have some knowledge of UK trade, ideally in beauty

**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We’re looking for an innovative and hands-on Senior Customer Marketing Manager to put Harvey’s EMEA customers centre stage: telling their stories, celebrating their wins, and building community around them.
  
  
Harvey has an incredible base of law firm and in-house customers across the region, and they are truly innovating the practice of law. Your first job is to elevate their voices: finding the customers doing standout work, earning their trust, and producing the written, video and spoken stories that put that work in front of the industry.
  
  
From there, the role expands into community programming: building the communities, programmes and moments (power user groups, customer roundtables, awards and recognition moments, customer-led content) that bring customers and the wider legal community together.
  
  
You’ll sit within the EMEA Marketing team and work hand in glove with our global Customer Engagement team, who own the overarching customer marketing strategy, programmes and playbooks. Your job is to make them work for EMEA: adapting them for the region’s markets, customers and culture, building what the region needs on top, and feeding what you learn back into the global motion. You’ll also partner closely with Customer Success and Sales. As the first dedicated customer marketer in the region, you won’t inherit a finished playbook. You’ll help write it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Localise the global motion for EMEA: take the programmes, playbooks and frameworks our Customer Engagement team builds globally and tailor them specifically for EMEA markets, customers and culture, working hand-in-hand to build a truly exceptional motion.
* Build the EMEA customer story pipeline: work across customer-facing teams to find the customers doing standout work, secure their participation and approvals, and keep a steady flow of stories in production.
* Tell their stories: own written stories, video stories, quotes and references end to end and to a standard the customer is proud to share.
* Get the stories seen: package each story for the channels that give it reach, localised for priority EMEA markets, and make sure Sales knows what exists and how to use it.
* Build the advocate bench: develop a roster of EMEA customers who can act as references, speakers, panellists and peer connectors, and track their participation so no one is over-asked and everyone gets recognised.
* Build EMEA community programmes: design and run the formats that bring customers together, such as power user groups, customer roundtables, practitioner communities, awards and recognition moments, each with clear goals and structured follow-up.
* Build repeatable playbooks and processes: the story production workflow, approvals process, reference tracking and community operating rhythm, so each new story and programme is faster to stand up than the last.
* Measure and improve impact: track stories produced, proof usage, reference activity, community engagement and contribution to pipeline, renewals and expansion.

**What You Have**

* 4-7 years of experience in customer marketing, customer advocacy, content marketing or community, ideally in B2B SaaS, technology or professional services.
* Proven experience producing content end to end. Excellent writer and interviewer, with the judgement to find the real story and the credibility to earn trust with senior legal and business leaders.
* Experience building or running events, customer communities and advocacy programmes.
* Strong relationship instincts: you enjoy spending time with customers and build trust quickly with them, Sales and Customer Success.
* Highly organised and operationally rigorous, with the ability to run multiple stories, programmes and stakeholders at once.
* Comfortable working autonomously and building from scratch in a fast-moving environment.
* Familiarity with using AI to scale your own work.
* Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, enterprise or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus. Additional European languages are a plus.

**Job Description**
Join POLITICO’s Events team in Europe to grow, engage and amplify audiences for POLITICO Live.
  
  
The
**Senior Marketing & Audience Manager**
is a hands-on, all-round event marketer responsible for delivering marketing and audience recruitment campaigns and leading event amplification across POLITICO’s European events portfolio.
  
  
We’re looking for someone with
**fresh ideas, energy and creativity**
— someone ready to challenge the traditional event marketing playbook, experiment with new approaches and find innovative ways to engage audiences
**before, during and after our events**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong events marketing experience with a broader marketing background, including social media, CRM and digital campaigns, and experience mentoring or managing others. They will understand
**who needs to be in the room**
across the French, British, Spanish and EU policy communities.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Working with the Executive Director of Audience and Growth, lead the event audience team and deliver integrated marketing and audience recruitment campaigns.
* Drive registrations and attendance while attracting the right audiences for each event.
* Lead event amplification, finding creative ways to extend the reach and impact of our events before, during and after they happen.
* Bring fresh ideas, test new approaches and challenge established ways of working.
* Develop campaigns across email, CRM, social media, newsletters and other POLITICO channels.
* Use CRM and event marketing tools to effectively segment, target and engage audiences.
* Track performance and use data and insights to improve results.
* Collaborate with Events, Marketing, Editorial and Commercial teams to maximize the reach of POLITICO Live.

**What You'll Need**

* 6+ years of experience in events marketing, audience development or wider marketing.
* Team management experience.
* Strong all-round marketer with hands-on event promotion experience.
* Creative and curious, with the confidence to experiment and bring new ideas.
* Strong understanding of social media, email, CRM and digital marketing.
* Strong copywriting, organizational and project management skills.
* Data-driven and comfortable measuring and optimising campaigns.
* Able to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment.
* Fluent English; French and/or Spanish is a plus.
* Experience in media, policy, journalism or political events is an advantage.

**We value our people**
**Our Benefits Package Is Built For You, And Includes**

* Our teams benefit from country-specific, competitive compensation and benefits packages—including pension, healthcare, training opportunities and more.
* With a multinational team, strong ties to EU institutions, and flexible work options including working from abroad, we offer our employees an environment that supports both professional and personal development.

**Let’s keep in touch**
You can view our list of open positions here. We hope to see your application soon!
  
  
**About Us**
POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.
  
  
Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.
  
  
Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.
  
  
Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.
  
  
These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.
  
  
POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today.
